profile.ja: 吸血鬼と人間のハーフでありながら対魔忍として生きる異端の存在。“ふうま八将”のひとりでもあった祖父・心願寺幻庵から剣術の指南を受け、ゆくゆくは八将を継ぐと目されていた実力者。しかしかつての内紛でふうま宗家に助力した咎で幻庵は失脚。紅も里を離れ、現在はどこにも属さない独立した立場で行動している。元ふうま八将という出自から、宗家の跡取りであるふうま小太郎とも旧知の間柄。彼女は己に眠る“魔”の力を意図的に暴走させることで強大な力を得ることができる。その際、紅の眼は朱く染まり、背には漆黒の翼が発現、体の周囲には闇の瘴気をまとう。この魔人覚醒状態の紅は人とはかけ離れた凄まじい力を持つが、その代償として心身が“魔”に蝕まれ、徐々に人としての理性や意思を失っていくことになる。
profile.en: She is a half-vampire, half-human outcast who lives as a Taimanin. She received swordsmanship instruction from her grandfather, the Fuuma Eight-General Shinganji Gen-an, and was once slated to inherit his position. However, because her grandfather was disgraced for aiding the Fuuma main family during an internal conflict, Kurenai left the village and now operates independently with no allegiance. From her former Fuuma Eight-General lineage she is also an old acquaintance of Fuuma Kotaro, the heir of the main family. She can deliberately unleash the dormant "demon" power within herself to gain overwhelming strength. When she does, her eyes turn crimson, black wings sprout on her back, and she becomes surrounded by a miasma of darkness. In this demonic awakening, Kurenai possesses a terrifying power far beyond that of ordinary humans, but the price is that her body and mind are gradually consumed by the demon, causing her to lose her humanity and will over time.

text.ja: 助けが必要のようだな、力を貸そう。この姿の事か？　気にするな、力を出し惜しんでいる場合ではないというだけだ
text.en: Looks like you need help. I'll lend you my strength. This form? Don't worry about it—there's no time to hold back.

text.ja: この姿でいる間、私は少しずつ魔に蝕まれていくだろう……だが、そう簡単に心を明け渡しはしないつもりだ
text.en: While I'm in this form, I'll be slowly corrupted by the demon… but I don't intend to surrender my heart so easily.

text.ja: とめてくれるな。たとえ忌まわしき“魔”に堕ちようと、私には貫かねばならない正義がある
text.en: Don't try to stop me. Even if I fall into that abhorrent "demon," I have justice I must see through.

text.ja: どのような姿だろうと紅は紅、か……お前ならそう言うと思っていたが、実際に言われると心が軽くなるな
text.en: No matter what form I take, I'm still Kurenai… you thought I'd say that, huh? Hearing it actually lightens my heart.

text.ja: さあ、任務に行こう。この忌まわしくも強力な力を存分に振るわせてくれ。他ならない、お前のために、な
text.en: Come on, let's go on the mission. Let me unleash this abhorrent yet powerful force to its fullest. For none other than you.

text.ja: 気遣いの必要などないぞ。お前に勝利を捧げるためなら……何、私を失っては意味がない？　……なら、気を引き締めねばな
text.en: You don't need to worry about me. If it's to give you victory… what, losing me would be meaningless? Then I must steel myself.

text.ja: この姿でいる時は、いつ魔にのまれるかと不安になる事もある。けど不思議だ。お前といると、そんな気持ちにはならないんだ
text.en: When I'm in this form I sometimes worry about when the demon will swallow me. But it's strange—when I'm with you, I never feel that way.

text.ja: もし私の心が魔に蝕まれ切ってしまう事があれば、その時はお前に殺されたい。そんな顔をするな。頼む、約束してくれ
text.en: If my heart ever becomes completely consumed by the demon, I want you to kill me then. Don't make that face. Please, promise me.

text.ja: ふふふふ、この姿でするのも、新鮮でいいんじゃないか？　お前が喜ぶなら、そのためだけにこの力を解放してもいいぞ
text.en: Heh heh heh, doing this in this form is fresh and nice, right? If it makes you happy, I can release this power just for you.

text.ja: この姿だと、なんだか無性にお前をイジメたくなってしまうんだ……今日は私から、責めてもいいか？
text.en: In this form I just want to tease you endlessly… Can I torment you today?

text.ja: あぁぁ……あふっ、うぅん……この力を以ってしても、お前には敵わないようだ……魔よりも前に、お前に心奪われているからかな
text.en: Ahhh… *pant*… Even with this power, I can't beat you… maybe it's because I'm already stolen by you before any demon could.
